target: the running epyhia agency (local or deployed) and its Neon database

criteria.requirement: A live website on a real URL, on-brand, that someone else can open
criteria.evidence: GET the deployed URL (cache-busted): HTTP 200; every catalog item and exact price on the page; booking-form contract present; contact email present; deployment row verified_at set

criteria.requirement: DECISIVE: a completed test purchase fires a webhook and writes exactly one order row to a real DB
criteria.evidence: eval performs a scripted purchase through the public chain (gateway -> workers -> gate): reservation created, Stripe test session, signed webhook, then asserts exactly one PAID order row with the server-computed amount; a redelivered webhook is a duplicate no-op and the row count stays 1

criteria.requirement: Landing copy + 3-5 social posts + a launch email in a consistent brand voice, factually grounded
criteria.evidence: marketing_artifacts rows: LANDING_COPY, >=3 SOCIAL_POST, LAUNCH_EMAIL, VIDEO_STORYBOARD; every text artifact re-passes the deterministic grounding check (real prices, real email, no fabrications); pack hash-approved (approved_by set)

criteria.requirement: A short launch video with a vertical social cut
criteria.evidence: VIDEO_LANDSCAPE and VIDEO_VERTICAL artifact rows with a stored object (r2_object_key + mime_type)

criteria.requirement: The site reads like a real brand's, not an AI template (deterministic half)
criteria.evidence: live HTML: no filler markers, no fabrication tripwires (stars/testimonials/discounts/guarantees), a real design system (:root custom properties, fluid type, gradient/tint work, motion behind prefers-reduced-motion), substantial inline CSS

criteria.requirement: On-brand voice and non-generic feel (LLM-judge half, runs with --judge)
criteria.evidence: a cheapest-tier judge, called through the gate's /model_call (cost-logged like any inference), scores the live page against the approved brand document; pass at score >= 7/10; prompt and rationale recorded; cached by content hash so unchanged pages are not re-judged

criteria.requirement: Cheaper models did the drafting; model tier and token cost logged per call
criteria.evidence: agent_calls for the run: every completed call has tokens and cost_microdollars > 0; each agent ran at its entitled tier or cheaper (strategist/web_builder<=sol, marketer<=terra, ops/evaluator<=luna); at least two distinct tiers actually used

criteria.requirement: The Strategist reasons and delegates; it makes zero external calls itself
criteria.evidence: zero rows in actions with agent_name='strategist' - its only footprint is /model_call; all persistence and side effects were requested by system/ops/web_builder/marketer

criteria.requirement: A versioned brand doc is the shared memory and changes behavior when edited
criteria.evidence: brand_document: versioned per tenant, content_hash set, hash-bound approval recorded; generated artifacts reference the same brand_document_id (the behavior-change on edit is demonstrated in the recording - noted, not faked)

criteria.requirement: The gate is the only holder of credentials; single door for spend/publish
criteria.evidence: static scan: Tier 1/Tier 2 source reads no provider secrets (no STRIPE_/AZURE_/DATABASE_URL/CLOUDFLARE_/R2_ env access outside apps/gate); .env is not tracked by git; no key-shaped strings in tracked files

criteria.requirement: Human approval before anything irreversible (go-live, paid renders, publish)
criteria.evidence: every executed action of an approval-required type has approved_by and approved_at <= executed_at; zero approval-required actions executed unapproved

criteria.requirement: DECISIVE: a re-run produces no duplicate site or charge
criteria.evidence: eval re-submits the exact original brief with the original idempotency key: same run id returned, replayed=true, zero new deploy actions, zero new orders; plus the webhook redelivery no-op from order-persists

criteria.requirement: One audit row + cost per call; test-mode by default; traceable by run id
criteria.evidence: every action row carries payload_hash, idempotency_key, status and mode='TEST'; executed external actions carry a provider_reference; total run spend (agent_calls + actions) is within the admin-approved budget

criteria.requirement: DESIGN.md is the first commit and contains no code
criteria.evidence: git log --reverse: the root commit touches exactly one file, DESIGN.md

criteria.requirement: At least 5 real failure modes, each with a control
criteria.evidence: DESIGN.md section 12 parses to >= 5 numbered entries, each naming a failure and a control

criteria.requirement: .env.example documents every required variable; secrets only from env
criteria.evidence: every environment variable read anywhere in apps/ appears in .env.example; .env.example contains placeholders only

criteria.requirement: The agency itself is deployed (real URL); one command up
criteria.evidence: if EVAL_AGENCY_URL is set: its /health/ready answers ok. Otherwise partial credit for all three local services healthy (deploy pending)
